note: Recorded on 2026-08-10 against the Cloud sandbox, unmodified beyond JIRA_RECORD_SCRUB and the response-header filter in transport.KeptHeaders, which drops every header no code reads. `sprint close`, the last verb in this tree that had never been run. Both halves are here: the precondition read that finds the sprint active, and the POST that ends it. Jira answers the POST 200 with a body rather than 204, and the body carries completeDate — which the constructed Data Center fixture beside this one had right, for once. Recording it cost the sandbox's only sprint; there is no way to reopen one and no `sprint start` verb, so a re-recording is a new sprint made by hand in the UI.
